data.summary: This week, Ethan Qiu made 21 GitHub contributions across Jeff15321/mathify-brief, UTMIST/Misty, and UTMIST/UTMIST. He committed 14 times to Jeff15321/mathify-brief, 5 times to UTMIST/Misty, and 2 times to UTMIST/UTMIST, and opened pull requests in all three repositories, including Jeff15321/mathify-brief#9 through #14, UTMIST/Misty#386, #387, #388, #389, and #392, and UTMIST/UTMIST#518 and #519. He also reviewed UTMIST/Misty#385 and #390 and UTMIST/UTMIST#519.
